title: Luxury Chalets with Private Pools | Kozara Panoramic Resort
meta_description: Discover luxury mountain chalets with private heated pools near Banja Luka. Enjoy untouched nature, panoramic views, and 5-star comfort. Book your Kozara escape today.
hero_subtitle: Peaceful nature escape near Banja Luka & Croatia. Enjoy untouched nature, panoramic views, and 5-star comfort.

highlight_serenity_desc: Every chalet features its own panoramic outdoor pool with temperature control option.
highlight_location_desc: Only 45 minutes from Banja Luka Airport and close to the Croatian border.
intro_title: Discover a Unique Boutique Resort in the Mountains of Kozara
intro_desc: Experience five private luxury chalets, each thoughtfully designed with its own swimming pool and panoramic mountain views. Perfect for couples, families, and guests looking to escape the noise of the city and reconnect with nature.
wcu-title: Why Guests Love Kozara Panoramic Resort
benefit-desc1: Private swimming pool for every chalet, ensuring total exclusivity.
benefit-desc2: Absolute peace and silence in nature, far from the urban rush.
benefit-desc3: Panoramic views stretching across the landscapes of Bosnia and Croatia.
showcase_title: Five Unique Spirits, One Luxury Standard
showcase_desc: Our five private chalets are identical in structural design, sharing premium wood configurations, 5-star interior setups, and uniform direct pricing.
blueprint_desc: Built sustainably with solid timber framing, underfloor heating, fully-featured kitchens, and expansive glazed terrace panels.
chalet_wind_desc: Fresh mountain breezes and freedom in every breath.
chalet_sun_desc: Glowing with golden morning light and positive warmth.
chalet_star_desc: Standalone placement below the others for total romantic privacy.
chalet_sky_desc: Boundless horizons and direct access to mountain clear air paths.
chalet_cloud_desc: Float above the mists in complete silence and inspiring peace.
teaser_desc: Only five private chalets hidden on our mountain slope.
brochure_desc: Prepare for your escape to Mount Kozara by downloading our comprehensive handbook. Formatted perfectly for your offline viewing.
brochure_card_desc: Includes resort map grid, village directions, and local safety rules.

story_title: Our Story: Luxury and Peace in Perfect Harmony
story_desc: Kozara Panoramic Resort was born from a passion for untouched nature and the vision that premium luxury accommodation can exist in total harmony with the environment. Our mission is to provide a secluded mountain retreat where guests find a deep balance between comfort and serenity.
story_desc2: Nestled in the lush landscapes of Northern Bosnia, our resort offers an unforgettable boutique experience. Our modern private chalets provide complete intimacy while offering all the high-end amenities of a luxury villa, including private heated pools and underfloor heating. At Kozara Panoramic Resort, time slows down, allowing you to reconnect with nature in an elegant, tranquil setting near Gradiška and Banja Luka.
kozara_desc: Mount Kozara, famously known as the “air spa” of the Balkans, is a unique destination where the air is exceptionally pure. As the green jewel of Western Krajina, it offers a natural health retreat perfect for spiritual renewal and physical recovery. Its dense pine forests and crystal-clear mountain streams create an oxygen-rich microclimate that is rare in today’s world.
kozara_desc2: Kozara is more than just a destination; it is an experience of freedom, making it the perfect nature escape near Banja Luka for adventurers and families alike.
kozara_desc3: Kozara is much more than just a destination; it's an experience of freedom, making it the perfect nature escape near Banja Luka for adventurers and families.

blog_post2_title: Dragana and James create a paradise for hedonists on Kozara

book_meta_desc: Securely book your boutique mountain chalet with a private heated pool at Mount Kozara. Best rate guaranteed with flexible payment options.
book_occupant_limit_warning: Maximum total limit is 6 persons per cabin. Families must supervise children around pools.
book_pay_property_desc: No credit card authorization required online. Settle on the mountain.

book_adv_1: Best price guaranteed over external agents
faq_spirit_desc: At Kozara Panoramic Resort, we combine the rugged wilderness of the Balkans with 5-star continental comforts. Whether you have questions about our private heated pool operational seasons, local check-in hours, unpaved local access roads, GP support, or self-catering hampers, our team is always nearby to help.
faq_help_desk_desc: Need immediate offline assistance with airport transfers or special welcome hamper arrangements?
faq_guidelines_desc: To preserve the pristine, quiet natural spa atmosphere for all guests, we kindly request observance of our resort values.
faq_guide_1_desc: To honor our absolute zero-noise night sky, we ask all guests to preserve quiet hours between 22:00 and 08:00 hrs. Loud speaker devices are not permitted outdoors during these hours.
faq_guide_2_desc: No glass bottles or glassware are allowed directly around the pool borders or stone deck paths. Families must supervise children around pools and open balconies at all times.
faq_guide_3_desc: Kozara mountain receives dramatic snowfalls during winter. By local regulations, winter tyres are required starting in November. Basic 4x4 options are suggested for deep snow stays.
faq_contact_desc: If you couldn't find the answer you were looking for, please don't hesitate to contact us directly.

A.question: Is there air conditioning in the chalets?
A.answer: Yes. All chalets are equipped with air conditioning for guest comfort during warmer months.

A.question: Which airport is closest to the resort?
A.answer:
Banja Luka International Airport is the closest airport at approximately 45 minutes driving time.

Other convenient airports include:

  • Zagreb Airport – approximately 2 hours depending on border crossing times
  • Sarajevo International Airport – approximately 3.5 hours
  • Belgrade Nikola Tesla Airport – approximately 4 hours

Airport transfer assistance may be available upon request depending on availability.

A.question: Is there an ATM nearby?
A.answer: Yes. ATMs are available in Gradiška, approximately 25–30 minutes from the resort.

B.question: Can we barbecue at the resort?
B.answer:
Yes. Modern Ninja Woodfire electric BBQ facilities may be available for rent depending on the chalet
                    and season.

B.question: Is cycling possible around the resort?
B.answer:
Yes. The Kozara region offers beautiful cycling opportunities through forests, hills, panoramic
                    countryside areas, and routes towards Kozara National Park.

B.question: How can I book the resort?
B.answer:
You can book directly through Kozara Panoramic Resort Official Website or via selected booking
                    platforms.

B.question: Is breakfast included?
B.answer:
The resort operates primarily as self-catering accommodation.

Will breakfast hampers be available in the future?

The resort may introduce optional organic breakfast hampers in the future featuring selected local products.

C.question: Is coffee provided in the chalets?
C.answer:
Yes. A small complimentary welcome supply of 4 coffee pods is provided for guests on arrival.

Which coffee system is used?

The chalets use the Nescafé Dolce Gusto coffee pod system.

Can we buy additional coffee pods nearby?

Yes. Additional Dolce Gusto coffee pods can easily be purchased in supermarkets and shops in Gradiška.

C.question: What is your cancellation policy?
C.answer: Cancellation policies depend on the booking platform and selected rate.

C.question: How many people can stay in one chalet?
C.answer: Each chalet can accommodate up to 6 guests.

C.question: Do the chalets have kitchens?
C.answer: Yes. Every chalet has a fully equipped kitchen.

C.question: What makes Chalet “Star” special?
C.answer:
Chalet “Star” is located separately below the other four chalets, providing:

  • Maximum privacy
  • A standalone location
  • Panoramic valley views
  • A peaceful romantic atmosphere
  • One of the best sunrise and sunset positions at the resort

Is Chalet “Star” more expensive?

No. Chalet “Star” follows the same pricing structure as the other chalets depending on season and availability.

Why is Chalet “Star” often unavailable?

It is usually the first chalet to be booked because of its exceptional privacy and location.

How do we request Chalet “Star”?

Guests may request Chalet “Star” during the booking process depending on availability.

Can we access Chalet “Star” by car?

Yes. Guests staying in Chalet “Star” may access the chalet area by car for arrival, unloading luggage, and collecting luggage at departure. General guest parking is otherwise located separately outside the main chalet areas to help maintain the peaceful atmosphere and privacy around all chalets.

C.question: What are standard times?
C.answer:
Standard check-in is normally between 08:00 and 14:00 hrs. Standard check-out time is 10:00 hrs.

Is self check-in available?

Yes. Self check-in is available 24/7 with prior notice and advance arrangement with the resort.

C.question: Is the resort family friendly?
C.answer:
Yes. Families are welcome, and the chalets are suitable for families with children.

Children remain the responsibility of parents or guardians at all times, especially around pools, terraces, and outdoor areas.

C.question: Can foreign currency be exchanged?
C.answer:
Yes. Major international currencies can easily be exchanged into Convertible Marks (KM/BAM) in
                    Gradiška.

D.question: Is direct booking cheaper?
D.answer: Direct booking may offer the best available prices and special offers.

D.question: Is there a doctor nearby?
D.answer:
Yes. The resort also has access to its own private General Practitioner (GP) for guest consultations
                    if required.

D.question: Are drones allowed?
D.answer: Please ask reception before operating drones at the resort.

E.question: Is early check-in possible?
E.answer: Early check-in may be possible depending on chalet preparation and occupancy levels.

E.question: Can electric vehicles charge at the resort?
E.answer: A dedicated electric vehicle charging station is planned for the resort as soon as possible.

E.question: Are emergency contact details available?
E.answer: Yes. Important local emergency numbers and contact details are provided inside the chalets.

E.question: Is English spoken at the resort?
E.answer: Yes. Resort staff can assist international guests in English.

F.question: Can food be delivered to the resort?
F.answer:
Yes. Local food delivery may be arranged before arrival or during your stay depending on availability.

Requests are preferably made by email or written message to help ensure accuracy.

F.question: Can we reserve the entire resort?
F.answer:
Yes. Full resort bookings may be arranged for:

  • Family reunions
  • Wellness retreats
  • Team-building events
  • Small weddings
  • Private celebrations

G.question: Is German spoken at the resort?
G.answer: Basic German communication may also be available.

G.question: Do you offer gift vouchers?
G.answer: Yes. Gift vouchers and special stay packages may be available.

G.question: Are glass bottles allowed near the pools?
G.answer: No. For guest safety, glass is not permitted near pool areas.

G.question: Can groceries be delivered before arrival?
G.answer:
In some cases, groceries or welcome items may be arranged before arrival or during your stay
                    depending on availability.

H.question: Is there a hair dryer in the chalet?
H.answer: Yes. Each chalet is equipped with a good-quality hair dryer for guest use.

H.question: Is there heating in the chalets?
H.answer: Yes. The chalets feature underfloor heating and additional heating systems.

H.question: Are there hiking trails nearby?
H.answer:
Yes. The surrounding hills and forests provide scenic walking and hiking opportunities. Day visits
                    to Kozara National Park are also possible.

H.question: Is housekeeping provided during the stay?
H.answer:
Housekeeping arrangements depend on stay length and booking type. Additional housekeeping may be
                    available upon request.

I.question: What is your instagram page?
I.answer: Check out Kozara Panoramic Resort Instagram.

I.question: Are the chalets insulated?
I.answer: Yes. The chalets are designed for comfort in both summer and winter conditions.

I.question: Is there Wi-Fi at the resort?
I.answer: Yes. Free Wi-Fi is available throughout the resort and chalets.

J.question: Who created Kozara Panoramic Resort?
J.answer:
Kozara Panoramic Resort was created by James and Dragana Truscott as a family project combining
                    British and Bosnian influences with a shared vision of building a peaceful panoramic nature retreat
                    focused on privacy, relaxation, comfort, and authentic hospitality.

K.question: Is Kozara National Park nearby?
K.answer:
Yes. Kozara National Park is within reach by car and is ideal for hiking, cycling, sightseeing, and
                    enjoying nature.

L.question: Is late checkout possible?
L.answer: Late checkout may be available depending on occupancy and prior arrangement.

L.question: Is laundry service available?
L.answer: Limited laundry assistance may be available depending on occupancy and staffing.

L.question: What should we enter into our satnav?
L.answer: Detailed arrival instructions and GPS guidance will be sent before arrival.

L.question: What happens if I forget something at the resort?
L.answer: Please contact the resort as soon as possible.

L.question: Is loud music allowed?
L.answer:
Guests are kindly asked to respect the peaceful atmosphere of the resort, especially during quiet
                    hours.

L.question: Can luggage be stored before check-in or after check-out?
L.answer: Limited luggage storage may be possible by prior arrangement.

M.question: Is there a minimum stay requirement?
M.answer: Minimum stay requirements depend on the season and selected chalet.

M.question: Is there mobile phone signal?
M.answer:
Yes. Depending on your provider and location at the resort, you may receive both Bosnian and
                    Croatian (EU) mobile network options.

M.question: Can music be played during exclusive full-resort bookings?
M.answer: Yes. Reasonable music and social activities may be permitted if one group rents all 5 chalets.

N.question: What makes the resort special?
N.answer:
The resort offers private luxury wooden chalets with heated pools, panoramic views, fresh mountain
                    air, silence, privacy, and peaceful relaxation surrounded by nature.

N.question: Can we use the pool at night?
N.answer: Yes. Pools feature lighting for evening use. Pool use is always at guests’ own risk.

O.question: Do the chalets have private terraces?
O.answer:
Yes. Every chalet includes its own private panoramic terrace area featuring high-quality sliding
                    double-glazed glass systems, creating a flexible indoor living space with the option to fully open
                    the sliding doors during warmer weather.

P.question: Is parking available?
P.answer: Yes. Free parking is available close to the chalets.

P.question: Is this a party resort?
P.answer:
No. Kozara Panoramic Resort is primarily designed as a peaceful nature and wellness retreat.

Are parties allowed?

No large uncontrolled parties are permitted.

P.question: What payment methods do you accept?
P.answer: We accept cash, major bank cards, bank transfer, and selected digital payment methods.

P.question: Is there a petrol station nearby?
P.answer: Yes. Petrol stations are available in the wider Gradiška region.

P.question: Are pets allowed?
P.answer: Yes. Smaller pets and registered assistance dogs may be permitted by prior arrangement.

P.question: Is there a pharmacy nearby?
P.answer: Yes. Pharmacies are available in Gradiška.

P.question: Is the resort good for photography?
P.answer:
Absolutely. Many guests visit specifically for the spectacular sunrises, panoramic cloud views,
                    sunsets, wildlife, and peaceful forest scenery.

P.question: How deep and large are the pools?
P.answer:
Each private pool measures approximately 6 metres x 3 metres and includes an integrated underwater
                    ledge bench for relaxing. The main swimming area has an approximate water depth of 1.40 metres.

P.question: Should children be supervised near the pools?
P.answer: Yes. Children must always be supervised by adults around the pool areas.

P.question: Does every chalet have its own pool?
P.answer:
Yes. Every chalet has its own private heated pool.

Are the pools heated?

Yes. Pools are heated during the operating season.

Are the pools private?

Yes. Each pool belongs exclusively to its chalet.

When are the pools open?

Pool season generally runs from spring until autumn depending on weather conditions.

Pool use is at guests’ own risk.

P.question: Which chalet is the most private?
P.answer: Chalet “Star” is the most private chalet, located separately below the other chalets.

Q.question: Is there a quiet time policy?
Q.answer:
Yes. Quiet hours are normally observed between 22:00 and 08:00.

Can quiet hours ever be relaxed?

Yes. If one group privately rents the entire resort, quiet time rules may be relaxed by prior agreement.

R.question: Is the resort suitable for remote working?
R.answer:
Yes. Many guests enjoy combining relaxation with remote work thanks to the peaceful environment and
                    Wi-Fi access.

R.question: Do returning guests receive special offers?
R.answer: From time to time, returning guests may receive loyalty offers or special promotions.

R.question: Are there restaurants nearby?
R.answer: Yes. Local restaurants are available within driving distance.

R.question: Is the resort suitable for couples?
R.answer:
Yes. Many guests visit for romantic escapes and wellness weekends.

Can you arrange romantic surprises?

Yes. Subject to availability, romantic decorations and special arrangements may be possible.

R.question: Is the road paved?
R.answer:
The final main access road to the resort is currently not paved. However, paving works are planned.

Is the road difficult in winter?

Winter tyres are required in line with local laws during snowy conditions.

S.question: Is there a safe in the chalet?
S.answer:
Yes. Each chalet includes its own private safe for storing valuables and important personal items
                    securely.

S.question: Is the resort safe?
S.answer: Yes. The resort is located in a peaceful countryside area and is monitored for guest safety.

S.question: Is the resort open all year?
S.answer:
Yes. The resort operates year-round.

Does it snow in winter?

Yes. Snowfall is possible during winter months.

Is the resort beautiful in autumn?

Yes. Autumn colours in Kozara are particularly beautiful.

Is summer very hot?

Summer temperatures can be warm, but the elevated hill location provides cooler evenings.

S.question: Is a security deposit required?
S.answer: A refundable security deposit may be requested depending on booking type.

S.question: Are supermarkets nearby?
S.answer: Yes. Supermarkets and local shops are accessible by car.

S.question: Is smoking allowed?
S.answer:
Smoking is not permitted inside the chalets or inside the glazed terrace areas.

Smoking may be permitted only in suitable outdoor areas while respecting neighbouring chalets, other guests, and the surrounding natural environment.

S.question: Can we tag the resort on social media?
S.answer: Yes. We love seeing guest photos and experiences shared online.

S.question: Is the resort suitable for stargazing?
S.answer:
Yes. Due to the peaceful countryside location with low light pollution, guests can often enjoy
                    beautiful night skies and star views.

T.question: Can the resort arrange airport or taxi transfers?
T.answer: Transfer assistance may be possible with advance notice depending on availability.

T.question: Is there a TV in the chalet?
T.answer: Yes. Smart TV systems are available.

T.question: Is Bosnia and Herzegovina safe for tourists?
T.answer: Yes. Bosnia and Herzegovina is generally considered very safe and welcoming for visitors.

T.question: Is tourist tax included?
T.answer: Tourist tax may be charged separately according to local regulations.

T.question: Are towels provided?
T.answer:
Yes. Bathroom and pool towels are provided.

Are bathrobes provided?

Yes. Bathrobes may be available on request.

T.question: How do we find the resort easily?
T.answer:
The final 5.1 km to the resort are signposted.

Guests are recommended to stay on the main roads towards the village of Turjak and use Google Maps, where Kozara Panoramic Resort is clearly marked.

U.question: Do the chalets have underfloor heating?
U.answer: Yes. The chalets are equipped with modern underfloor heating systems.

V.question: Can visitors come to the chalet?
V.answer: Only registered guests are permitted unless agreed with management.

W.question: Is the tap water safe?
W.answer: Yes. The water is suitable for normal use.

W.question: What is the weather like throughout the year?
W.answer:
Spring and autumn are generally mild and colourful, summers are warm with cooler evenings, and
                    winters may include snow.

W.question: Can flowers, wine, or romantic surprises be arranged?
W.answer:
Yes. Depending on availability and advance notice, the resort may help organise flowers, wine,
                    decorations, or romantic surprises.

W.question: Can we see wildlife nearby?
W.answer:
Occasionally yes. The area surrounding the resort is rich in nature and wildlife. Roe deer,
                    squirrels, and owls are native to Mount Kozara.

X.question: Do you offer extra experiences or special arrangements?
X.answer:
Yes. Depending on the season and availability, the resort may help arrange romantic surprises,
                    wellness experiences, local food deliveries, nature activities, or private full-resort bookings.

Y.question: Is the resort suitable for yoga, meditation, or wellness retreats?
Y.answer:
Yes. Activities may take place on terraces, near pools, or in peaceful outdoor areas surrounded by
                    nature.

Z.question: Is the resort quiet at night?
Z.answer:
Yes. One of the most valued features of Kozara Panoramic Resort is its peaceful and quiet natural
                    atmosphere.

notice_terms_1_d: A reservation is confirmed when the guest receives written confirmation via email or messaging apps.

notice_terms_3_s2_d: Strict cancellation protection rule: No refunds or cancellations are accepted under peak summer dates or designated holiday weeks.

notice_terms_4_li1: Use of pools is entirely at the guest's own risk.
notice_terms_4_li2: No lifeguard is on duty at the resort garden.
notice_terms_4_li3: Children must be supervised at all times.
notice_terms_4_li4: Absolute zero glass permitted near pool areas.
notice_terms_5_d: Smoking is strictly prohibited inside the wooden structures and double-glazed patios. Outdoor terrace smoking is permitted with care.
notice_terms_6_d: Domestic pets are accepted upon request prior to arrival. A separate charge of €15.00 per pet per stay is applied.
notice_terms_7_d: Maximum of 6 persons per chalet. Layout features 1 double bedroom, 2 twin single rooms, gallery loft options or custom sofa setups.
notice_priv_desc: PEVA d.o.o. collects and processes personal data strictly in accordance with regional registration compliance and legal security parameters.
notice_priv_1_d: We securely register: Full Name, Address, Phone Coordinates, Email registries, and legal ID/passport credentials. This is collected exclusively to fulfill reservation contracts, complete legal guest entry registries, and handle pre-arrival coordinates.
notice_priv_2_d: Your personal details are stored inside secure encryptions and are never sold or shared with commercial agents. Third-party transmissions are restricted only to the Tourist Organisation of Gradiška (legal BA tourism requirement) and processing checkout payment portals.
notice_priv_3_d: No personal logs or tracking coordinates are ever sold, traded, or transferred to unauthorized external entities. Digital payments are processed securely via Bankart / Stripe gateways.
notice_cookie_desc: To guarantee an optimal digital reservation flow, Kozara Panoramic Resort utilizes standard temporary cookie logs.
notice_cookie_1_d: Crucial for session retention and secure booking flow processing.
notice_cookie_2_d: Aggregated, anonymous metrics (via Analytics) deployed to observe load times and geographic traffic maps.
notice_cookie_consent: Consent Protocol: By remaining on the official domain (kozarapanoramicresort.ba), you acknowledge and consent to our strictly necessary technical deployment logs.
notice_priv_note: Under data regulations, guests can request complete deletion of their commercial data profiles post-checkout, provided all legal booking retention tax duties are fulfilled.
notice_cookie_p1: This resort website uses basic cookies to facilitate user-navigation, remember display choices, analyze traffic, and ensure a secure reservation experience.
notice_cookie_p2: By continuing to explore our mountain pages or confirming check-in, you agree to place essential cookies on your devices. Analytics tracking (such as Google Tag Manager) is activated only with your explicit accept confirmation.
notice_price_desc: We maintain an absolute zero-hidden-fee pricing standard. All rates calculated during direct checkout contain complete property services.
notice_price_inc_d: Underfloor heating, electrical hobs, private pools, high-speed WiFi, secure parking, towels, bedsheets, and final sanitization sweeps.
notice_price_exc_d: Local government tourism tax is not calculated in the web rate and is added separately at the checkout. Optional private GP medical support or custom BBQ Ninja rentals are settled upon request.
